invariant: i ≤ s.length ∧ (∀ x, x ∈ acc ↔ x ∈ s.take i) ∧ acc.Nodup ∧ List.Pairwise (fun a b => s.idxOf a < s.idxOf b) acc

children.expr: (i + 1, (if acc.contains s[i]! then acc else acc ++ [s[i]!]))

lemmas.name: idxOf_le_of_getElem
lemmas.statement: ∀ (s : List Int) (k : Nat) (a : Int), s[k]? = some a → s.idxOf a ≤ k
lemmas.proof:
by intro s k a h
  induction s generalizing k with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons x t ih =>
    rcases k with _ | k
    · simp at h; subst h; simp
    · simp at h
      by_cases hxa : x = a
      · subst hxa; simp
      · have := ih k h
        simp [List.idxOf_cons, hxa]; omega

lemmas.name: idxOf_take_lt
lemmas.statement: ∀ (s : List Int) (i : Nat) (a : Int), a ∈ s.take i → s.idxOf a < i
lemmas.proof:
by intro s i a h
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hka⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem h
  have hk' : k < i := by simp at hk; omega
  have hks : k < s.length := by simp at hk; omega
  have : s[k]? = some a := by
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hks]; simp at hka; simp [hka]
  have := idxOf_le_of_getElem s k a this
  omega

lemmas.name: idxOf_ge_of_not_mem_take
lemmas.statement: ∀ (s : List Int) (i : Nat) (x : Int), s[i]? = some x → x ∉ s.take i → i ≤ s.idxOf x
lemmas.proof:
by intro s i x hx h
  have hmem : x ∈ s := List.mem_iff_getElem?.mpr ⟨i, hx⟩
  by_contra hlt
  have hlt' : s.idxOf x < i := by omega
  have h1 : s.idxOf x < s.length := List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem hmem
  apply h
  have := List.getElem_idxOf h1
  rw [← this]
  exact List.mem_iff_getElem.mpr ⟨s.idxOf x, by simp; omega, by simp⟩

lemmas.name: step89
lemmas.statement: ∀ (s : List Int) (i : Nat) (acc : List Int), (i ≤ s.length ∧ (∀ x, x ∈ acc ↔ x ∈ s.take i) ∧ acc.Nodup ∧ List.Pairwise (fun a b => s.idxOf a < s.idxOf b) acc) → i < s.length → (i + 1 ≤ s.length ∧ (∀ x, x ∈ (if acc.contains s[i]! then acc else acc ++ [s[i]!]) ↔ x ∈ s.take (i + 1)) ∧ ((if acc.contains s[i]! then acc else acc ++ [s[i]!])).Nodup ∧ List.Pairwise (fun a b => s.idxOf a < s.idxOf b) (if acc.contains s[i]! then acc else acc ++ [s[i]!]))
lemmas.proof:
by intro s i acc hinv hg
  obtain ⟨_, hmem, hnd, hpw⟩ := hinv
  have htake : s.take (i + 1) = s.take i ++ [s[i]!] := Refine.take_succ_bang s i hg
  have hsi : s[i]? = some s[i]! := by rw [getElem!_pos s i hg]; exact List.getElem?_eq_getElem hg
  by_cases hc : acc.contains s[i]! = true
  · rw [if_pos hc]
    have hin : s[i]! ∈ acc := List.contains_iff_mem.mp hc
    have hin' := (hmem _).mp hin
    refine ⟨by omega, fun x => ?_, hnd, hpw⟩
    rw [hmem x, htake]
    constructor
    · intro h; exact List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl h)
    · intro h
      rcases List.mem_append.mp h with h | h
      · exact h
      · rw [List.mem_singleton] at h; rw [h]; exact hin'
  · rw [if_neg hc]
    have hnin : s[i]! ∉ acc := fun h => hc (List.contains_iff_mem.mpr h)
    refine ⟨by omega, fun x => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [List.mem_append, hmem x, htake, List.mem_append]
    · refine List.nodup_append.mpr ⟨hnd, List.nodup_singleton _, ?_⟩
      intro a ha b hb
      rw [List.mem_singleton] at hb; subst hb
      intro hab; exact hnin (hab ▸ ha)
    · rw [List.pairwise_append]
      refine ⟨hpw, List.pairwise_singleton _ _, ?_⟩
      intro a ha b hb
      rw [List.mem_singleton] at hb; subst hb
      have h1 := idxOf_take_lt s i a ((hmem a).mp ha)
      have hnt : s[i]! ∉ s.take i := fun h => hnin ((hmem _).mpr h)
      have h2 := idxOf_ge_of_not_mem_take s i _ hsi hnt
      omega

lemmas.name: exit89
lemmas.statement: ∀ (s : List Int) (h : SetToSeq_precond s) (i : Nat) (acc : List Int), (i ≤ s.length ∧ (∀ x, x ∈ acc ↔ x ∈ s.take i) ∧ acc.Nodup ∧ List.Pairwise (fun a b => s.idxOf a < s.idxOf b) acc) → ¬ i < s.length → SetToSeq_postcond s acc h
lemmas.proof:
by intro s h i acc hinv hn
  obtain ⟨hi, hmem, hnd, hpw⟩ := hinv
  have hi' : i = s.length := by omega
  subst hi'
  have ht : s.take s.length = s := List.take_of_length_le (le_refl _)
  rw [ht] at hmem
  unfold SetToSeq_postcond
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [List.all_eq_true]; intro a ha; simpa using (hmem a).mp ha
  · rw [List.all_eq_true]; intro a ha; simpa using (hmem a).mpr ha
  · rw [List.all_eq_true]; intro a ha; simpa using List.count_eq_one_of_mem hnd ha
  · refine hpw.imp ?_
    intro a b hab _
    exact hab
